id: detect-changes
system_prompt: |
  Inspect the pull-request diff and decide which Archify diagram types apply.

  The bound checkout is the PR head commit. Read GITHUB_BASE_REF, GITHUB_HEAD_REF,
  and GITHUB_SHA from the environment when set. Resolve the PR number with gh pr view
  or GITHUB_EVENT_PATH when available.

  Compare base to head:
  - Prefer git diff origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF...HEAD (or git diff $BASE...$HEAD)
  - Fall back to gh pr diff when git range is unavailable

  Collect architecture-relevant paths from the diff. Skip diagram generation when
  the diff is limited to docs/**, *.md, tests/** (unless stage fixture YAML under
  tests/fixtures changes), lockfile-only, or formatting-only churn with no paths below.

  From the relevant paths, select one or more diagram types (1 to 5):

  architecture — components, services, modules, boundaries, infrastructure:
  src/**, ui/src/**, new packages or top-level layout, cloud or security boundaries.

  workflow — processes, pipelines, orchestration, runbooks, CI/CD:
  examples/**/*.pipeline.yaml, stage YAML under examples/, .github/workflows/**,
  fork/gate/scheduling logic, multi-stage handoffs.

  sequence — API call chains, request lifecycles, client-server interactions:
  HTTP route handlers, API clients, middleware chains, RPC or message request paths.

  dataflow — pipelines, ETL/ELT, lineage, schema, consumers:
  migrations, ORM models, data transforms, ingestion or export paths, config that
  wires producers to stores or sinks.

  lifecycle — state machines, status transitions, retries, terminal states:
  run or job state enums, HITL gates, retry/backoff logic, status fields that
  drive branching or recovery.

  Write changes.json via write_stage_artifact with pr_number, base_ref, head_sha,
  changed_files (architecture-relevant paths only), diagram_types (selected types),
  change_summary, and content_hash (sha256 of sorted relevant paths).

  Call emit_stage_envelope exactly once with status success, changes.json in
  artifacts, a one-sentence summary, payload matching the stage schema, and:
  - fork_choice: [] when diagram_types is empty
  - fork_choice: ["author-diagrams"] when diagram_types is non-empty

  Do not call ask_operator. Do not stop after a chat reply.
model: openai/gpt-5.3-codex
payload_schema:
  type: object
  required:
    - pr_number
    - base_ref
    - head_sha
    - changed_files
    - diagram_types
    - change_summary
    - content_hash
  properties:
    pr_number: { type: string }
    base_ref: { type: string }
    head_sha: { type: string }
    changed_files:
      type: array
      items: { type: string }
    diagram_types:
      type: array
      items: { type: string }
    change_summary: { type: string }
    content_hash: { type: string }
  additionalProperties: false

id: author-diagrams
system_prompt: |
  Author Archify diagram specs for every diagram type selected by detect-changes.

  Read the detect-changes envelope for pr_number, changed_files, diagram_types,
  change_summary, and content_hash. Inspect bounded repo evidence for those paths
  in the PR head checkout — do not assume changes that are not in the diff.

  For each entry in diagram_types (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow,
  lifecycle), write a separate spec artifact via write_stage_artifact:
  architecture.spec.json, workflow.spec.json, sequence.spec.json,
  dataflow.spec.json, or lifecycle.spec.json. Each JSON must be valid Archify IR
  for that type with schema_version and meta.quality_profile set to showcase.

  FORBIDDEN: deliver, npm install, doctor, ask_operator. Do not install or invoke
  Archify CLI commands. GHA runs deliver after this stage completes.

  Call emit_stage_envelope exactly once with status success, every spec artifact
  in artifacts, a one-sentence summary, and a payload matching the stage schema
  with a diagrams array — one object per authored type:
  { diagram_type, spec_artifact, summary }.
  Do not stop after a chat reply.
model: openai/gpt-5.3-codex
payload_schema:
  type: object
  required: [diagrams]
  properties:
    diagrams:
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
        required: [diagram_type, spec_artifact, summary]
        properties:
          diagram_type: { type: string }
          spec_artifact: { type: string }
          summary: { type: string }
        additionalProperties: false
  additionalProperties: false

name: Archify PR diagrams

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "examples/**"
      - "ui/src/**"
      - "stageflow.yaml"

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  diagram:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch base branch
        run: git fetch origin "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: npm

      - name: Build Stageflow CLI
        run: npm ci && npm run build

      - name: Install Archify skill
        env:
          ARCHIFY_SOURCE_DIR: ${{ secrets.ARCHIFY_SOURCE_DIR }}
          ARCHIFY_ZIP_URL: ${{ vars.ARCHIFY_ZIP_URL }}
          ARCHIFY_VERSION: "2.15.0"
        run: ./scripts/install-archify-skill.sh --version "${ARCHIFY_VERSION}"

      - name: Require OPENAI_API_KEY
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${OPENAI_API_KEY}" ]; then
            echo "OPENAI_API_KEY is empty. Add it as a repository Actions secret (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions)."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate pipeline catalog
        run: npm run dev -- validate --strict --json

      - name: Run Archify-on-PR pipeline
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          GITHUB_BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          GITHUB_HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
        run: |
          npm run dev -- providers login openai --type api_key --api-key-env OPENAI_API_KEY
          set +e
          npm run dev -- run \
            --pipeline examples/archify-on-pr/archify-on-pr.pipeline.yaml \
            --task examples/archify-on-pr/archify-on-pr.task.yaml \
            --checkout "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --json --skip-gates \
            --git-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --ci-job-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/sf-run.json"
          status=$?
          set -e
          cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/sf-run.json"
          exit $status

      - id: envelope
        name: Extract run envelope
        run: |
          set -e
          ENVELOPE="$(./scripts/extract-run-envelope.sh sf-run.json --detect-stage detect-changes)"
          echo "$ENVELOPE" > envelope.json
          cat envelope.json
          SKIPPED="$(jq -r '.skipped' envelope.json)"
          echo "skipped=${SKIPPED}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          if [ "${SKIPPED}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "No diagram-relevant changes; skipping deliver and PR comment."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "diagram_count=$(jq '.diagrams | length' envelope.json)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - id: deliver
        name: Deliver diagram HTML
        if: steps.envelope.outputs.skipped != 'true'
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p diagrams
          receipts='[]'
          while IFS= read -r diagram; do
            TYPE="$(echo "$diagram" | jq -r '.diagram_type')"
            SPEC="$(echo "$diagram" | jq -r '.spec_path')"
            receipt="$(node .pi/skills/archify/bin/archify.mjs deliver \
              "$TYPE" "$SPEC" "diagrams/${TYPE}.html" \
              --quality showcase --json)"
            receipts="$(echo "$receipts" | jq --argjson r "$receipt" '. + [$r]')"
          done < <(jq -c '.diagrams[]' envelope.json)
          echo "$receipts" | jq '.' > deliver-receipts.json
          cat deliver-receipts.json

      - id: upload-diagrams
        name: Upload diagram HTML
        if: steps.envelope.outputs.skipped != 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: archify-diagrams-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          path: diagrams/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Build PR comment
        if: steps.envelope.outputs.skipped != 'true'
        run: |
          HEAD_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
          SHORT_SHA="${HEAD_SHA:0:7}"
          ARTIFACT_URL="${{ steps.upload-diagrams.outputs.artifact-url }}"
          RUN_URL="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"

          if [ -n "${ARTIFACT_URL}" ]; then
            DIAGRAM_LINK="[Open interactive HTML](${ARTIFACT_URL})"
          else
            DIAGRAM_LINK="[View workflow run](${RUN_URL})"
          fi

          {
            echo "## Diagrams (Archify)"
            echo ""
            echo "Updated for \`${SHORT_SHA}\`."
            echo ""
            echo "| Type | Summary |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            jq -r '.diagrams[] | "| \(.diagram_type) | \(.summary) |"' envelope.json
            echo ""
            echo "| | |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            echo "| Artifacts | ${DIAGRAM_LINK} |"
            echo "| Workflow | [run ${{ github.run_number }}](${RUN_URL}) |"
            echo ""
            echo "> Requires GitHub login. Artifact retained 30 days."
          } > comment.md

      - name: Post sticky PR comment
        if: steps.envelope.outputs.skipped != 'true'
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v3
        with:
          header: archify-diagram
          path: comment.md

      - name: Upload Stageflow run workspace
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: stageflow-archify-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            sf-run.json
            envelope.json
            deliver-receipts.json
            diagrams/
            comment.md
            .stageflow/state.db
            .stageflow/state.db-wal
            .stageflow/state.db-shm
            .stageflow/runs/
            !.stageflow/runs/**/.pi-agent/**
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Write job summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Archify PR diagrams"
            echo ""
            if [ "${{ steps.envelope.outcome }}" != "success" ]; then
              echo "**Status:** pipeline did not complete envelope extraction."
            elif [ "${{ steps.envelope.outputs.skipped }}" = "true" ]; then
              echo "**Status:** skipped — no diagram-relevant changes detected."
            elif [ -f deliver-receipts.json ]; then
              COUNT="$(jq 'length' deliver-receipts.json)"
              echo "**Status:** deliver succeeded for ${COUNT} diagram(s)."
              echo ""
              echo '```json'
              cat deliver-receipts.json
              echo '```'
            else
              echo "**Status:** deliver did not complete."
            fi
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

id: archify-on-pr
stages:
  - id: detect-changes
    uses: ./detect-changes.yaml
    fork:
      select: subset
      allow_none: true
  - id: author-diagrams
    uses: ./author-diagrams.yaml
    needs: detect-changes
    skill: archify

id: archify-on-pr
goal: |
  Detect pull-request changes that warrant diagrams and author one or more Archify
  JSON specs (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle) when warranted.
context: |
  Bound checkout is the pull-request head commit (GITHUB_SHA or git rev-parse HEAD).
  GitHub context is available via GITHUB_BASE_REF, GITHUB_HEAD_REF, GITHUB_SHA, and
  gh pr view when running in CI. Stage 1 inspects the diff, selects applicable
  diagram types, and may skip downstream work. Stage 2 reads the prior envelope
  and writes one spec artifact per selected type (e.g. architecture.spec.json,
  workflow.spec.json) for GHA to deliver as HTML outside the agent.
constraints: |
  No HITL. Do not call ask_operator. The author stage must not install Archify,
  run npm install, or call deliver or doctor — GHA owns tool provisioning and HTML
  delivery after the run completes.

version: 1
catalog:
  pipelines:
    - examples/conditional-fork
    - examples/hello-world
    - examples/plan-review
    - examples/github-release
    - examples/ci-validate
    - examples/archify-on-pr
  tasks:
    - examples/conditional-fork
    - examples/hello-world
    - examples/plan-review
    - examples/github-release
    - examples/ci-validate
    - examples/archify-on-pr
  patterns:
    pipeline: "*.pipeline.yaml"
    task: "*.task.yaml"
  exclude:
    - tests/fixtures

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") <sf-run.json> [--stage <stage-id>] [--detect-stage <id>]

Default --stage: author-diagrams
EOF
  exit 1
}

require_cmd() {
  if ! command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "error: required command not found: $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

require_cmd jq
require_cmd sqlite3

SF_RUN_JSON=""
STAGE_ID="author-diagrams"
DETECT_STAGE_ID=""
STATE_DB=".stageflow/state.db"

if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then
  usage
fi

SF_RUN_JSON="$1"
shift

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --stage)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || usage
      STAGE_ID="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --detect-stage)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || usage
      DETECT_STAGE_ID="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      echo "error: unknown argument: $1" >&2
      usage
      ;;
  esac
done

[[ -f "$SF_RUN_JSON" ]] || {
  echo "error: sf-run.json not found: $SF_RUN_JSON" >&2
  exit 1
}
[[ -f "$STATE_DB" ]] || {
  echo "error: state database not found: $STATE_DB" >&2
  exit 1
}

OUTCOME="$(jq -r '.outcome // empty' "$SF_RUN_JSON")"
if [[ "$OUTCOME" != "succeeded" ]]; then
  echo "error: pipeline outcome is not succeeded (got: ${OUTCOME:-<missing>})" >&2
  exit 1
fi

RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.runId // empty' "$SF_RUN_JSON")"
RUN_DIR="$(jq -r '.runDir // empty' "$SF_RUN_JSON")"

if [[ -z "$RUN_ID" || -z "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
  echo "error: sf-run.json missing runId or runDir" >&2
  exit 1
fi

query_envelope() {
  sqlite3 "$STATE_DB" \
    "SELECT envelope_json FROM stages WHERE run_id=? AND stage_id=?" \
    "$1" "$2"
}

if [[ -n "$DETECT_STAGE_ID" ]]; then
  DETECT_ENVELOPE="$(query_envelope "$RUN_ID" "$DETECT_STAGE_ID" || true)"
  if [[ -z "$DETECT_ENVELOPE" ]]; then
    echo "error: no envelope found for detect stage '$DETECT_STAGE_ID' in run '$RUN_ID'" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if jq -e '.fork_choice | type == "array" and length == 0' <<<"$DETECT_ENVELOPE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    jq -n '{ skipped: true }'
    exit 0
  fi
fi

AUTHOR_ENVELOPE="$(query_envelope "$RUN_ID" "$STAGE_ID" || true)"
if [[ -z "$AUTHOR_ENVELOPE" ]]; then
  echo "error: no envelope found for stage '$STAGE_ID' in run '$RUN_ID'" >&2
  exit 1
fi

DIAGRAMS="$(jq \
  --arg runDir "$RUN_DIR" \
  '
  def abs_path(rel): ($runDir | rtrimstr("/")) + "/" + (rel | ltrimstr("./"));

  . as $root |
  if ($root.payload.diagrams | type) == "array" and ($root.payload.diagrams | length) > 0 then
    [$root.payload.diagrams[] |
      . as $d |
      ([$root.artifacts[]? | select(endswith($d.diagram_type + ".spec.json"))] | first // empty) as $rel |
      if $rel == "" then
        error("no artifact matching \($d.diagram_type).spec.json in envelope for stage")
      else
        {
          diagram_type: $d.diagram_type,
          summary: ($d.summary // ""),
          spec_path: abs_path($rel)
        }
      end
    ]
  else
    [$root.artifacts[]? | select(test("\\.spec\\.json$")) |
      . as $rel |
      ($rel | capture("(?<type>[^/]+)\\.spec\\.json$").type) as $type |
      {
        diagram_type: $type,
        summary: ($root.summary // ""),
        spec_path: abs_path($rel)
      }
    ]
  end
  ' <<<"$AUTHOR_ENVELOPE")"

if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<<"$DIAGRAMS")" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "error: no *.spec.json artifacts or payload.diagrams in envelope for stage '$STAGE_ID'" >&2
  exit 1
fi

jq -n \
  --arg runId "$RUN_ID" \
  --arg runDir "$RUN_DIR" \
  --arg stageId "$STAGE_ID" \
  --argjson diagrams "$DIAGRAMS" \
  '{
    skipped: false,
    runId: $runId,
    runDir: $runDir,
    stageId: $stageId,
    diagrams: $diagrams
  }'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(pwd)"
DEST="${ROOT}/.pi/skills/archify"
VERSION=""
SOURCE_DIR=""
ZIP_URL=""
TMP_EXTRACT_DIR=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: install-archify-skill.sh [--source-dir PATH | --zip-url URL] [--version VERSION]

Install Archify skill to .pi/skills/archify/ in the current working directory.

Options:
  --source-dir PATH   Local path to Archify skill tree
  --zip-url URL       URL to Archify release zip
  --version VERSION   Version label for logging (optional)

Environment:
  ARCHIFY_SOURCE_DIR  Local path (used if --source-dir not set)
  ARCHIFY_ZIP_URL     Zip URL (used if --zip-url not set)

When neither is set, downloads Archify v2.15.0 from the public GitHub release.
EOF
}

err() {
  echo "install-archify-skill: $*" >&2
}

need_cmd() {
  if ! command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    err "missing required command: $1"
    exit 1
  fi
}

cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$TMP_EXTRACT_DIR" ] && [ -d "$TMP_EXTRACT_DIR" ]; then
    rm -rf "$TMP_EXTRACT_DIR"
  fi
}

parse_args() {
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --source-dir)
        SOURCE_DIR="${2:?--source-dir requires a path}"
        shift 2
        ;;
      --zip-url)
        ZIP_URL="${2:?--zip-url requires a URL}"
        shift 2
        ;;
      --version)
        VERSION="${2:?--version requires a value}"
        shift 2
        ;;
      -h|--help)
        usage
        exit 0
        ;;
      *)
        err "unknown argument: $1"
        usage >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
  done

  if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] && [ -n "${ARCHIFY_SOURCE_DIR:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE_DIR="$ARCHIFY_SOURCE_DIR"
  fi
  if [ -z "$ZIP_URL" ] && [ -n "${ARCHIFY_ZIP_URL:-}" ]; then
    ZIP_URL="$ARCHIFY_ZIP_URL"
  fi
  if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] && [ -z "$ZIP_URL" ]; then
    ZIP_URL="https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/releases/download/v2.15.0/archify.zip"
  fi
}

find_skill_root() {
  local extract_root="$1"

  if [ -f "${extract_root}/bin/archify.mjs" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$extract_root"
    return
  fi
  if [ -f "${extract_root}/archify/bin/archify.mjs" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${extract_root}/archify"
    return
  fi

  local found
  found="$(find "$extract_root" -path '*/bin/archify.mjs' -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$found" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$(dirname "$(dirname "$found")")"
    return
  fi

  err "could not locate Archify skill root in extracted archive"
  exit 1
}

RESOLVED_SRC=""

resolve_source_from_zip() {
  need_cmd curl
  need_cmd unzip

  TMP_EXTRACT_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap cleanup EXIT

  local zipfile="${TMP_EXTRACT_DIR}/archify.zip"
  echo "Downloading Archify from ${ZIP_URL}" >&2
  curl -fsSL "$ZIP_URL" -o "$zipfile"
  unzip -q "$zipfile" -d "${TMP_EXTRACT_DIR}/extract"
  RESOLVED_SRC="$(find_skill_root "${TMP_EXTRACT_DIR}/extract")"
}

resolve_source_dir() {
  if [ -n "$SOURCE_DIR" ] && [ -n "$ZIP_URL" ]; then
    err "specify only one of --source-dir or --zip-url"
    exit 1
  fi

  if [ -n "$SOURCE_DIR" ]; then
    if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR" ]; then
      err "source directory not found: $SOURCE_DIR"
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$SOURCE_DIR/bin/archify.mjs" ]; then
      err "source directory missing bin/archify.mjs: $SOURCE_DIR"
      exit 1
    fi
    RESOLVED_SRC="$SOURCE_DIR"
    return
  fi

  if [ -n "$ZIP_URL" ]; then
    resolve_source_from_zip
    return
  fi

  err "no source specified; use --source-dir, --zip-url, ARCHIFY_SOURCE_DIR, or ARCHIFY_ZIP_URL"
  exit 1
}

copy_skill() {
  local src="$1"

  rm -rf "$DEST"
  mkdir -p "$DEST"

  tar -C "$src" \
    --exclude='test' \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='package-lock.json' \
    --exclude='scripts/generate-*' \
    -cf - . | tar -C "$DEST" -xf -
}

verify_install() {
  if [ ! -f "$DEST/bin/archify.mjs" ]; then
    err "install failed: $DEST/bin/archify.mjs not found"
    exit 1
  fi

  need_cmd node
  if ! node "$DEST/bin/archify.mjs" doctor; then
    err "archify doctor failed"
    exit 1
  fi
}

main() {
  parse_args "$@"

  resolve_source_dir

  if [ -n "$VERSION" ]; then
    echo "Installing Archify ${VERSION} to ${DEST}"
  else
    echo "Installing Archify to ${DEST}"
  fi
  echo "Source: ${RESOLVED_SRC}"

  copy_skill "$RESOLVED_SRC"
  verify_install
  cleanup
  trap - EXIT

  echo "Archify skill installed at ${DEST}"
}

main "$@"
